en:
I'm glad you came, Shuichi!
Remember! Today's your last chance, okay?

<CLT=cltMIND>I see Kokichi is just as
chipper as usual.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know when he's being serious
and when he's toying with me... Which is it?

Now, it's time for the final game!
It's this... Ta-daaaa!

Whoa! A knife!?
What are you...?

Nee-heehee...don't get so antsy.
Don't worry—it's only for the game.
You know what the knife game is, right?
The knife game?

Place your palm on the table with fingers apart.
With the knife, stab between your fingers.
What!? That's so dangerous!

This will be today's challenge.
This is fitting for the final game, isn't it?

But, this is...really dangerous...
What if we get hurt?

Hm, what are you talking about?
Shuichi, if you lose...

You'll be beyond just injured, y'know?
You'll die.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi's demeanor has changed...
he seems far more serious now.
I'll make the first move, okay?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi spread his fingers on the table,
then lifted the knife...

<CLT=cltMIND>I've never seen Kokichi
so serious before.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this what an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme Leader<CLT=cltMIND>
looks like...?
I'm ready!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*TAP TAP TAP TAP!*

<CLT=cltMIND>He's so fast!
If he can do that...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*SHK!*
Ouch!
K-Kokichi!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Blood oozed from Kokichi's hand.
I sprung into action and grabbed his wrist.

You don't have to keep going, stop!
Just stay still, I'll get it...

<CLT=cltMIND>I found a nearby first aid kit and
clumsily tended to Kokichi's cut.
<CLT=cltMIND>And all the while, Kokichi was...
Nee-heehee...

<CLT=cltMIND>Laughing. Laughing as if he
were having the time of his life.

Okay, I think that's good.
What do you think?

Yeah. It wasn't a deep cut, so that'll do.
Thanks for treating my injury, Shuichi.
But...

Aw maaaan, I lost!
Congrats, Shuichi! You win!

But I didn't do it yet...
I'm still the winner?

Well, I messed up. So yeah.
You win by default.
Plus, I already fulfilled my objective.
Objective...?
To kill you, Shuichi!
...But I'm alive.
I made your heart *die* with worry, didn't I?
...What?

After I said I'd kill you, I was on your mind
the whooole time, right?

You thought about whether or not I was serious,
or why I would say something confusing...

Ha, even now! You're concerned about me from
the bottom of your heart!

Nee-heehee... Now, you'll never *ever* forget
me for the rest of your life.

I stole your heart, so now I'm satisfied!
I don't need to steal your life anymore!

What does that even mean!?
Why did you say that?

Because that was a lie.
I never wanted your life to begin with.

And like I told you from the very beginning,
I'm a liar!

<CLT=cltMIND>I have nothing to say...
Toying with me would be putting it lightly.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't think there will ever come a day when
I truly understand Kokichi. I reach out to him...
<CLT=cltMIND>But he doesn't take my hand.

<CLT=cltMIND>But in his own way...I think that
helps me understand him a little.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've learned a new skill,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kind Lie<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I parted ways,
and I returned to my room.
